maddeler.e:
تساومت (form VI)
# تَسَاوَمْتُ (tasāwamtu) /ta.saː.wam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# تَسَاوَمْتَ (tasāwamta) /ta.saː.wam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# تَسَاوَمْتِ (tasāwamti) /ta.saː.wam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# تَسَاوَمَتْ (tasāwamat) /ta.saː.wa.mat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
